title.en: Friendly store staff alongside service disputes

text.en: Several pet owners praise the retail associates and groomers for their warm, helpful demeanor, highlighting staff members who handle nervous cats with patience during difficult nail trims. However, two dissatisfied customers reported negative experiences, criticizing management for failing to intervene during a vehicle towing dispute and noting an unsatisfactory grooming session.

Parking is a major point of frustration among reviewers visiting this Bucktown location. Multiple customers report that a third-party monitoring company aggressively boots and tows vehicles from the store parking lot even during quick customer visits, resulting in heavy fines. Although the retail store itself is described as clean and welcoming, the parking situation prompts severe warnings.

title.en: Gentle cat care alongside grooming complaints

text.en: Pet owners commend groomer Matthew for successfully trimming nails on anxious and spirited cats, noting that pets felt safe and cared for during their appointments. Dogs visiting the store are also welcomed warmly with treats. In contrast, one reviewer reported a very poor overall grooming appointment, creating a mixed picture for pet handling services.

q.en: Does this Kriser's location offer cat grooming services?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report scheduling cat nail trims and grooming appointments with the on-site groomer.

q.en: What should visitors know about parking at the store?

a.en: Reviewers strongly caution that the customer lot is strictly monitored by a third-party company that actively boots and tows cars.

q.en: Are dogs allowed inside the store while shopping?

a.en: Yes, customers regularly bring their dogs inside and report that staff greet pets warmly.
